task_title: Generated equipment keeps its base inherent stat line

plan_review.notes: Separate-model plan review (rubber-duck, gpt-5.6-sol) confirmed the root cause and raised 3 blocking concerns: (1) armor/accessory asymmetry is semantically unstable -> adopted its rule that ALL non-weapon bases inherit their authored non-armor line verbatim; (2) the Common legality check should read affix evidence from resolvedEffects rather than diffing stat maps -> implemented as generatedEquipmentInstanceHasAffixDrivenStatBonus; (3) a naive non-empty-statBonuses guard would wrongly fail weapons and could trip the rare-accessory exclusion-group limit -> guard now tests meaningfulness (weapon snapshot OR non-zero stat OR grant) and is scoped to Common plus the shipped quartermaster path.

rounds.notes: code-review agent on the full commit diff, briefed on double-counting, illegal-enhancement, encumbrance, quartermaster pricing and the Common reward contract: No significant issues found.

independent_grade.notes: The change correctly restores inherent non-armor stat lines for non-weapon bases, fixing issue #3697 where eight shipped bases (leather-gloves, merchant-sandals, charms, etc.) generated empty-stat Common items. The generator's new `inherentNonArmorStatBonuses` helper correctly excludes weapons and filters armor/zero entries. The legality invariant now checks affix-driven stats via `resolvedEffects` rather than diffing the full stat map, which is semantically precise. Test coverage is comprehensive: a new regression guard checks every shipped base at Common, a Quartermaster dead-item sweep covers 12 seeds × 2 epochs, existing tests are updated to assert inherent lines, and a specific leather-gloves identity test pins the exact stats. The three additional documentation files (handoff, apples metric, review ledger) are well-formed and consistent with repo policy for a 3-apple session. No determinism violations, no layer boundary violations, no dead code.
